s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of painful lower-extremity swelling and erythema with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Painful left lower-extremity swelling and erythema
Intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, decreased appetite, and palpitations
Ill-defined, warm, confluent erythema, edema, and tender induration on the left calf
Gastrocnemius myositis, extensive subcutaneous and superficial myofascial edema, and popliteal lymphadenopathy
key_facts: 53-year-old Hispanic man
Painful left lower-extremity swelling and erythema
Incidentally noted bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses six months earlier
Intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, decreased appetite, and palpitations
Denies trauma or injury to the leg
Mild lymphocytopenia, moderate anemia, elevated creatine kinase, elevated aldolase, and elevated lactate dehydrogenase
Peripheral-blood flow cytometry was unremarkable
CT and MRI of the leg revealed gastrocnemius myositis, extensive subcutaneous and superficial myofascial edema, and popliteal lymphadenopathy
No improvement with intravenous ceftriaxone for presumed cellulitis and pyomyositis
Punch biopsy of skin from the lower leg showed a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells

shortlist.label: Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Atypical mononuclear cells on biopsy and lack of response to antibiotics

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses

shortlist.label: Takayasu arteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses

raw.rationale: The presence of a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the punch biopsy, along with systemic symptoms such as intermittent fevers, night sweats, and weight loss, is consistent with Subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma. The lack of improvement with antibiotics and the presence of myositis and lymphadenopathy also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
rejected.why: Wegener's typically presents with granulomatous inflammation and vasculitis, which is not described in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Polyarteritis nodosa is a medium-vessel vasculitis that typically presents with hypertension, renal involvement, and abdominal pain, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Takayasu arteritis
rejected.why: Takayasu arteritis is a large-vessel vasculitis that typically presents with arm claudication, decreased pulses, and hypertension, which are not described in the vignette

rejected.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
rejected.why: Erdheim-Chester disease is a histiocytic disorder that typically presents with bone pain, exophthalmos, and diabetes insipidus, which are not mentioned in the vignette
